snapshot.text: Free, tax-funded public health system with strong primary care traditions, under financial strain since the economic crisis. A Cabinet-approved reform puts primary care and people-centred services first, with WHO reviewing the reform programme.

minister.name: Nalinda Jayatissa
minister.role: Minister of Health and Mass Media

priorities.title: Primary healthcare reform
priorities.text: MPs act as district health coordinators under a new Cabinet-approved reform centred on primary care.

priorities.title: Health investment programme
priorities.text: Over Rs 21 billion for nine new health projects in 2026, and 26 stalled major projects revived.
